newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo Biosciences names Hughes CFO.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo Biosciences names Hughes CFO.

text.p: Amarillo Biosciences Inc said Thursday that its vice president of finance and administration, Charles Hughes, has been named executive vice president and chief financial officer.
Both positions had been vacant, company employees said.
The company board also elected Brian McLean, an advisor to Whale Securities Co LP, as a director.

Amarillo Biosciences made an initial public offering of 2.3 million shares of stock in August. The biotechnology company is researching treatments for Sjogren's syndrome, oral mucositis in cancer patients and hepatitis B and C.
